`{ imported, expiresAt }` answer. Every answer

carries `Deprecation: true`, a
`Sunset` date and a `Link` to `.../accounts`.

An account this route creates is hosted-only. An
existing default it writes\ninto keeps whatever rule it had. Its `serverUrl` must be the URL saved in the\nproject, or the answer
is `400`. `authorizationServerUrl`, `oauthResourceUrl`\nand `tokens.id_token` are accepted and ignored. Move to\n`PUT .../accounts

/{account}`, which names the account it writes.

The error codes these routes add to `details.code` are listed in the
[error co

de reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md#server-account-errors).

The decisi
on summary composes steps 2 and 4 into one versioned object so every\nclient reads a run the same way. Four things to know before

gating on it:

* **`measurementUnit` ships with every count.** Under per-case grading the
 counts are case-execution *variants
*, with iterations as trials inside them;\n under a suite-wide accuracy threshold they are trials. The same suite reports\n a di
fferent total under each — 3 against 15 for three cases run five times —\n so a count without its unit is not a fact, and a rate

is never converted
